publication: Eugene Lukacs, Pacific Journal of Mathematics 8 (1958), no.3, 487-501
passage: Introduction, complete Theorem B, printed 487 (PDF index 1); introduction distinguishes Marcinkiewicz historical theorem from the paper extensions
comparison: Classical broader exponential-polynomial characteristic-function obstruction. The present pure-order positivity proof instead uses two zero diagonal moments and a nonzero cross moment, without assigning a positive law to a formal generating series.
limits: Original Marcinkiewicz full text and a full proof comparison of the broader theorem were not reviewed here. No new Gaussian characterization or priority claim.
